message.content:
Add LIVE DNS verification to the Nxeon Cold Email Engine, replacing the self-attested SPF/DKIM/DMARC checkboxes with real DNS lookups. Nxeon = Next.js App Router + Prisma + Postgres at /opt/nxeon.

Work ONLY in an isolated worktree. First run: `cd /opt/nxeon && git worktree add /opt/nxeon-build-dns -b feature/coldemail-dns-verify main`. Then work exclusively in /opt/nxeon-build-dns. NEVER touch /opt/nxeon or /opt/nxeon-staging (no cd/build/writes/git there), never systemctl/deploy/prisma-db-push, never edit .env. First `cd /opt/nxeon-build-dns && npm ci`. Verify pwd+branch before building. `npx tsc --noEmit` MUST be 0 errors (a full `next build` can't finish in the worktree — no DATABASE_URL — that's expected; rely on tsc). Prefer NO schema change (just set the existing SPF/DKIM/DMARC verified booleans on Brand/SendingDomain from a real lookup); if you must add a field keep it additive.

STUDY: lib/coldemail/compliance.ts, lib/actions-coldemail.ts, the Brands + Domains admin pages (app/admin/coldemail/{brands,domains}) and their Controls components, and the existing Brand/SendingDomain models (SPF/DKIM/DMARC verified flags).

BUILD: a server action `verifyDomainDns(domain, dkimSelector?)` in lib/actions-coldemail.ts (requireArea("platform")) that does real Node `dns.promises.resolveTxt` lookups: SPF = a TXT at the domain apex starting `v=spf1`; DMARC = a TXT at `_dmarc.<domain>` starting `v=DMARC1`; DKIM = a TXT at `<selector>._domainkey.<domain>` containing `v=DKIM1`/`k=`/`p=` (default selector e.g. "default", let the operator specify). Return each as verified/not + the raw record found (or the error). Wire a "Verify DNS" button on the Brands page (per brand's sending domain) and the Domains page (per SendingDomain, incl. tracking-domain CNAME check via resolveCname) that runs the action and SETS the stored verified flags from the REAL result (never just a manual checkbox). Keep the manual checkboxes as a fallback but make the live-verify the primary path; show the actual record found + a green/red result. Pure DNS-parsing helpers should be unit-tested (SPF/DMARC/DKIM record recognition). Update docs.

FINISH: tsc 0 errors; tests pass; commit + `git push -u origin feature/coldemail-dns-verify`. Report: what you added, whether any schema changed, and the staging command `cd /opt/nxeon && bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh feature/coldemail-dns-verify`. Do NOT deploy.

6044	tracking pixels so 50%+ of "opens" are machine-generated. Inbox access is now gated by **authentication**

## Cold Email Engine — LIVE DNS verification (2026-08-11)

Replaces the **self-attested** SPF/DKIM/DMARC checkboxes with **real DNS lookups**. Built on branch
`feature/coldemail-dns-verify`. **No schema change** — it just SETS the existing `spf/dkim/dmarcVerified` (and
`trackingDomainVerified`) booleans on `Brand` / `SendingDomain` from the live result. The manual checkboxes
stay as a fallback, but the live check is the primary path.

**Why not the system resolver.** The lookups go through the zone's **authoritative nameservers**
(`authoritativeResolver` in `lib/mail/deliverability.ts`), never `dns.promises` off the local resolver. This
host's `/etc/hosts` + `nsswitch` once produced a confidently *wrong* DNS diagnosis (the DKIM incident), so
cold-email verification reuses the same resolver-trap-proof path as the mail deliverability self-check.

### What was added
- **`lib/coldemail/dns.ts`** — PURE, unit-tested recognition + verdict builders (no I/O): `isSpfRecord` /
  `isDmarcRecord` / `isDkimRecord`, `dkimPublicKey`, `find*Record`, and `buildSpfCheck` / `buildDmarcCheck` /
  `buildDkimCheck` / `buildCnameCheck` → each returns `{ verified, record, error }`. SPF/DMARC verify on
  exactly one record (multiple = permanent error); DKIM needs a non-empty `p=` key; tracking needs a CNAME.
- **`lib/mail/deliverability.ts`** — `authoritativeResolver` + `txtAt` are now exported and a `cnameAt` helper
  added (reused, not duplicated).
- **Server actions in `lib/actions-coldemail.ts`** (each `requireArea("platform")`):
  - `verifyDomainDns(domain, dkimSelector?, trackingDomain?)` — read-only live lookup, returns the full
    `DnsVerifyResult` (SPF apex TXT `v=spf1`; DMARC `_dmarc.<domain>` `v=DMARC1`; DKIM
    `<selector>._domainkey.<domain>` `v=DKIM1`/`k=`/`p=`; optional tracking CNAME). Default selector
    `"default"`, operator-overridable per check.
  - `verifyBrandDns(brandId, dkimSelector?)` — verifies the brand's `sendingDomain` (falls back to the From
    address domain) and **writes** `spf/dkim/dmarcVerified` from the real result.
  - `verifySendingDomainDns(id, dkimSelector?)` — verifies the outreach FQDN `<subdomain>.<domain>` + tracking
    CNAME, writes the auth + `trackingDomainVerified` flags, and auto-advances PENDING → WARMING (stamping
    `warmupStartedAt`) once SPF+DKIM+DMARC are all live-green — same rule as the manual `setDomainVerification`.
- **UI** — `components/admin/coldemail/DnsVerify.tsx` (`BrandDnsVerify`, `SendingDomainDnsVerify`): a **Verify
  DNS** button + DKIM-selector input that runs the action and shows the actual record found with a green/red
  result per check. Wired into the Brands page (per brand) and Domains page (per sending domain, incl. the
  tracking CNAME). The old manual checkbox forms remain, relabelled "manual fallback".

**Selector:** operator-specified per check (default `"default"`), NOT persisted — keeps the change
schema-free. **Tests:** `test/coldemail-dns.test.ts` — 11 cases over the pure recognition/verdict helpers.
`tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; full suite 1031 pass. Guardrails: no schema change, no send, no `.env`/deploy.

## What I added

**Pure, unit-tested core** — `lib/coldemail/dns.ts`: record recognition (`isSpfRecord`/`isDmarcRecord`/`isDkimRecord`, `dkimPublicKey`, `find*Record`) and verdict builders (`buildSpfCheck`/`buildDmarcCheck`/`buildDkimCheck`/`buildCnameCheck`), each returning `{ verified, record, error }`. SPF/DMARC require exactly one record (multiple = permanent error); DKIM requires a non-empty `p=` key; tracking requires a CNAME.

**Server actions** in `lib/actions-coldemail.ts` (all `requireArea("platform")`):
- `verifyDomainDns(domain, dkimSelector?, trackingDomain?)` — read-only live lookup returning the full result: SPF at apex (`v=spf1`), DMARC at `_dmarc.<domain>` (`v=DMARC1`), DKIM at `<selector>._domainkey.<domain>`, optional tracking CNAME. Default selector `"default"`.
- `verifyBrandDns(brandId, ...)` — verifies the brand's sending domain (falls back to From-address domain) and **writes** the real `spf/dkim/dmarcVerified` flags.
- `verifySendingDomainDns(id, ...)` — verifies the outreach FQDN `<subdomain>.<domain>` + tracking CNAME, writes auth + `trackingDomainVerified`, and auto-advances PENDING→WARMING when all three are live-green.

**Resolver reuse** — a key finding: the codebase already has a resolver-trap-proof path (`authoritativeResolver`/`txtAt` in `lib/mail/deliverability.ts`) built after the DKIM incident. Rather than the naive `dns.promises` off the local resolver (which the DKIM memory explicitly warns against), I exported those helpers, added a `cnameAt`, and route all lookups through the zone's authoritative nameservers.

**UI** — `components/admin/coldemail/DnsVerify.tsx` (`BrandDnsVerify`, `SendingDomainDnsVerify`): a "Verify DNS" button + DKIM-selector input wired into the Brands and Domains pages, showing the actual record found with green/red per check. Manual checkboxes kept as a relabelled fallback.

**Tests/docs** — `test/coldemail-dns.test.ts` (11 cases); `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` updated with a new section.

## Schema
**No schema change.** It only sets the existing `spf/dkim/dmarcVerified` and `trackingDomainVerified` booleans. The DKIM selector is operator-specified per check (default `"default"`), deliberately not persisted to keep it schema-free.
